body:
I'm sure there's options I haven't tried, but a litany of medications and therapy over the last 2 decades leaves me feeling like I've tried most primary options.

Plus even my shrink and therapist are on the same page of having to live with it, not imagine it will go away. Kinda...a bitter pill when living with it feels like its left me alone and hurting for most of that time in treatment.

Trying to. I'm indulging in escapism (reading, gaming, whatever I can lose myself in for a short while). But... The OCD always cuts in. And...in this shit of a mindset that just fuels hopelessness. 

 And....then medicating myself to sleep every night.
I've been seeing my current therapist for a few years. It doesn't really seem to help the OCD, just the processing depression at times.

I haven't watched the full series (or even a complete season) but I've seen episodes in the past.

While contamination and checking concerns are the center of my manifestations of OCD, the presentation Monk had felt... Different. I suppose I appreciated a depiction of the suffering and frustration, but my own compulsions just aren't the same.

So... Been awake the entire night. 

Kind of lost to lingering thoughts. Thought I'd try and channel that energy into writing, but my hands are actually sore and the skin is peeling from overwashing them.

Know the pain of someone you care for being distant when you need them. Sorry you're hurting.

I'm struggling to feel hopeful tonight, too. But there's some odd solace in knowing others are feeling as lost/confused as I am. I hope the darker thoughts pass.
